messages:
alex: Heads up — canary deploy pushed ~30m ago caused p99 token latency to spike from ~78ms -> ~210ms on model-7. CI perf job failed, seeing visible regressions in canary metrics. https://ci.redwood/perf/jobs/1780456789

maria: oof. saw a few failing assertions in the harness logs too. any immediate diffs to blame?

alex: quick repo diff points at the recent merge that touched the kernel selector + batching heuristics: commit 9f3b2e7. local microbench shows worse branch/memory behavior on newer kernel. sample from ci log:
```
P99=210ms P50=24ms throughput=-12%
kernel=matmul_opt_v2 selected for seq>512
cache-misses++ on inner gemm
```

tej: can we bisect? i can run the perf harness across the tree if someone seeds the bisect script. alex, can you run `git bisect run` with dev/perf runner?

alex: starting git bisect now. command used:
```
git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad
git bisect run ./dev/perf/run_bench.sh --model=model-7 --seq=1024 --iters=200
```

ci-bot: Perf job triggered: perf/ci/bisect/1780456789 (status: running)

maria: note: there's also a kv-cache GC tweak in 4d2c1b that reduced max_cache_items from 2000 -> 1500. that could increase cache churn for long contexts and amplify kernel costs. worth keeping on the radar.

tej: bisect narrowed it down: regression introduced in 9f3b2e7 (kernel selector refactor). `9f3b2e7^` = good, `9f3b2e7` = bad. reproducible locally on a100 with our perf harness.

sara: if the selector now prefers matmul_opt_v2 for mid/long sequences, and that kernel has a suboptimal memory layout on a100, that matches the flamegraph. have we got profiles?

alex: added flamegraphs to the bisect job: https://perf.redwood/fg/1780456789. shows heavy hot in `matmul_opt_v2::gemm` and elevated mem-bandwidth.

tej: quick mitigation: propose revert of the selector change to restore prior kernel choices while we fix the kernel implementation/tuning. i'll draft a revert PR.

maria: +1 for revert as hotfix. also let's add a CI perf test that runs p99 latency for seq=1024 on model-7 to catch this in presubmit.

alex: opened PR: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/revert-9f3b2e7 — requesting canary redeploy once approved.

ci-bot: Canary redeploy triggered for infra@revert-9f3b2e7 (status: success)

ci-bot: Perf/ci result: P99=82ms P50=22ms throughput ~baseline. Marking perf alert as mitigated.

sara: follow-up items: create PERF task to profile matmul_opt_v2 with different macro-kernels, test on a100/GPU-specific codegen, and add selector unit tests.

alex: created tracker PERF-324 for the deep-dive and linked the bisect logs. closing this thread; re-open if it regresses again :thumbsup:
